race.comment: STORMING HOME (7) goes on top in her first start for the stable. Couldn't threaten on debut back in Feb but looks to have come on well during the break and gets Thompson sticking from two trials. Bold showing anticipated. CAVALLUNA (14)'s debut effort at Doomben reads better than the finishing position, only beaten 1.6L after picking up nicely late. Is sure to improve with that run under his belt and gets 2kgs off with 200m extra to reel them in. I AM LOUIE (2) was also only warming late when resuming at Ipswich. Couldn't meet expectations there but if they can better utilise the low draw this time he can play a major role. SON'S OF FORTITUDE (9) ran a bold debut third at Doomben at big odds, only beaten a neck, and if he handles the rise to 1400m he has enough upside to land a winning blow.
